summary: This note describes fall 2023 intramural sports at local colleges, explaining what intramurals are, their physical, mental and social benefits, and the sports on offer with start dates and team captains. It also covers registration, eligibility, facilities, safety, balancing academics, community involvement, and upcoming special events such as the September Showdown, Midnight Madness and Vancouver Volleybash.
one_line: Guide to fall 2023 intramural sports at local colleges, covering sports, start dates, registration, safety, and special events.
key_facts: Intramural sports are organized recreational leagues within a single institution, usually a college or university, without the rigor of varsity athletics.
Intramural soccer leagues start September 5th; the 'Campus Strikers', led by captain Luisa Hernandez, aim to defend their title.
Intramural basketball starts September 12th with a half-court format to encourage participation; Marcus Yee, a senior three-point specialist, leads last season's champions 'The Hoops I Did It Again'.
Indoor volleyball starts September 19th; team 'Block and Awe' is championed by seasoned player Priya Singh.
Ultimate Frisbee begins October 3rd and is a non-contact, self-refereed sport; Jake Thompson's 'Frisbee Frenzy' is a featured team.
Dodgeball league starts October 10th; Kate Morisato's reigning squad is 'The Dodging Devils'.
E-sports leagues open September 16th with 'League of Legends' and 'Rocket League'; Amir Chaudhry leads the team 'Ctrl+Alt+Defeat'.
Registration typically begins a few weeks before each sport's start date, via the college's intramural sports website or office, as individuals or teams.
Students, faculty, and in some cases alumni are eligible to play, and identification checks ensure fair play.
Colleges provide trained referees, first-aid equipped personnel, and equipment such as nets, knee pads, gaming consoles and soccer balls.
The 'September Showdown' on September 28th is a one-day competition between soccer and basketball teams.
'Midnight Madness' basketball is set for October 21st, with back-to-back games, skill contests and prizes into the early morning.
The 'Vancouver Volleybash' starts November 4th, is the largest fall event, and attracts teams from various colleges.
Local businesses often sponsor teams or games, creating a symbiotic relationship with the college.
